Messages.Author: koko Loco
Messages.Body:
VampiDroid is a vtes card reference/deckbuilding app I have downloaded from Android store for my Droid phone, it's not shabby and it’s free also.

Edit:-Nice job Francisco, Pascal and all involved

Edit: Useful for Android uses, not ipads/iphones.

Description
VampiDroid (vampidroid) is your reference app for Vampire: The Eternal Struggle™ (VTES) card game.

It is a mobile management solution for your cards. You will be able to browse and search cards. It will be helpful as a reference during games where you may check the card text or during deck building.

This app uses a cardlist from Vampire Elder Kindred Network site: www.vekn.net. I got a OK from jhattara administrator to include the cardlist database in this app.

Please, leave your comments and visit project homepage to send you bug reports and feature requests

Disclaimer notice:

Jyhad™, Vampire: The Eternal Struggle™ and all game symbols are trademarks of Wizards of the Coast, Inc. and CCP hf. White Wolf, World of Darkness and all related terms are trademarks of CCP hf. This product is not published nor endorsed by CCP hf.

Keywords:
VTES, Vampire, CG, card game"

Taken from:-https://market.android.com/details?id=name.vampidroid
